title: reply (bridge -> server)
description: The answer to one command (Arkab.Protocol.reply/2), with the command's id. Commands are applied one at a time in arrival order across all servers.

error.description: not_owner: an owner-only command from a server not joined as owner. unknown_command: a command frame without a cmd. bad_command: an unknown cmd or missing/ill-typed fields. no_such_board: resend of a board the bridge does not read. no_such_port: forget_port of a port it does not read. busy: the bridge did not get to it within 30 s.
